sloka: ब्राह्मणेन विशेषेण दत्तं तद्वक्तुमर्हसि ।एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण प्रत्युवाच महानृषिः ।। ७.७६.३६ ॥
transliteration: brāhmaṇena viśeṣeṇa dattaṁ tadvaktumarhasi ।evamuktastu rāmeṇa pratyuvāca mahānṛṣiḥ ।। 7.76.36 ॥

translations.english: Rama further requested the sage to explain the reason for accepting such a gift, especially when given by a Brahmana, to which the great sage then replied.
